outputs.explanation: Panel A is a 3D rendering/illustration of a structural volume (pre-conoidal rings and actin filament), not a plot of averaged quantitative data, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B is a 3D segmentation/rendering of cellular structures, not a plot showing averaged measurements.
Panel C is a tomogram slice (micrograph) with annotated filaments, not a graph of averaged data.
Panel D is an illustrative 3D rendering/cartoon of a lateral cell section, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel E shows a slice through an averaged subtomogram volume as an image; it is a representative image, not a quantitative plot with data points to display.
Panel F is a tomogram slice image showing a representative filament/myosin density, not a plot summarizing averaged data.
